### Domain Knowledge Context
The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.
[2] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

### Domain Knowledge Context
The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[2] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

### Domain Knowledge Context
The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - Use `K_POINTS automatic` with Monkhorst-Pack grid.
- `6 6 6 0 0 0` means 6×6×6 with no offset.
- For hexagonal cells, use offset `0 0 0` or `1 1 1` as recommended.
[2] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

### Domain Knowledge Context
The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[2] - M7 评分完成 (12.36), c2st_tool 第四次修复 self-check 通过
- M2 (16.83) 仍是 best. 精简 prompt 没超过 M2, 但 c2st 修复是基础设施改进.
[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

### Domain Knowledge Context
The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.

|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[2] - M7 评分完成 (12.36), c2st_tool 第四次修复 self-check 通过
- M2 (16.83) 仍是 best. 精简 prompt 没超过 M2, 但 c2st 修复是基础设施改进.
[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.
[4] | ID | 接口 | 实现 |
|----|------|------|
| G42 | `critique_decision` | `cli/rcb_runner.py` — `Decision` + `CritiqueResult` dataclass + 模板规则三层检查 + LLM 路径复用 adversarial_critique 独立调用 |
| G43 | recall 策略学习 | `metacog/__init__.py` — `_DEFAULT_RECALL_STRATEGIES` 7 条 + `load_recall_strategy` / `match_recall_strategy` / `update_recall_strategy` (S7 写入端, 原子写 .tmp + rename) |
| G44 | multi-agent metacog | `memory/longterm.py` — `HUGINN_MULTI_AGENT=True` opt-in + `_stable_principles_lock` 双平台 (msvcrt/fcntl) + best-effort 失败不阻断 |
[5] - **R19 状态机合并**: 4 套状态机 (autoloop engine + CSM + cognitive_engine + workflow state) → CSM 唯一状态机, 其他改 CSM 观察者. 大重构, 需独立测试周期
- **R18 历史 16.5MB 死重清理**: `git filter-repo --strip-blobs-with-ids large-blobs.txt`, 需备份 + 用户显式批准
- **L2 critique 扩展**: 当前 `critique_decision` 覆盖 mode/phase/tool, v6 扩展到 plan/strategy 层
- **active recall 策略学习**: 当前 G43 是手动策略表, v6 加 S7 自动学习

|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |

| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |

The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.
[1] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |

- M2 (16.83) 仍是 best. 精简 prompt 没超过 M2, 但 c2st 修复是基础设施改进.
[3] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[4] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

| G44 | multi-agent metacog | `memory/longterm.py` — `HUGINN_MULTI_AGENT=True` opt-in + `_stable_principles_lock` 双平台 (msvcrt/fcntl) + best-effort 失败不阻断 |

[2] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.

The following first-principles reference chunks may ground your answer. Cite the source numbers when relevant.

- M2 (16.83) 仍是 best. 精简 prompt 没超过 M2, 但 c2st 修复是基础设施改进.
[2] - A crystal is built by repeating a unit cell in three dimensions.
- 14 Bravais lattices grouped into 7 crystal systems.
- Lattice vectors `a, b, c` and angles `α, β, γ` define the unit-cell metric.

| Crystal system | Lattice condition | # Bravais | Laue group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Triclinic | a≠b≠c, α≠β≠γ | 1 | $\bar{1}$ |
| Monoclinic | a≠b≠c, α=γ=90°≠β | 2 | 2/m |
| Orthorhombic | a≠b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 4 | mmm |
| Tetragonal | a=b≠c, α=β=γ=90° | 2 | 4/mmm |
| Trigonal | a=b=c, α=β=γ&lt;120° | 1 | $\bar{3}m$ |
| Hexagonal | a=b≠c, α=β=90°, γ=120° | 1 | 6/mmm |
| Cubic | a=b=c, α=β=γ=90° | 3 | $m\bar{3}m$ |
[3] - Defined by vectors `a* = 2π (b × c) / V`, `b* = 2π (c × a) / V`, `c* = 2π (a × b) / V`
- Diffraction peaks occur when the scattering vector `Q = h a* + k b* + l c*`.
- For cubic lattice with constant a: `|Q| = 2π/d_hkl = (2π/a)·sqrt(h²+k²+l²)`.
- Brillouin zone = Wigner-Seitz cell of reciprocal lattice.
